captions.text: Cori can put events on Maya’s calendar.
Maya asks for a meeting with two people, at a time in New York.
She has Human Review on, so the plan waits for Start.
Before anything is saved, Cori shows the event: the title, 2 PM New York time, and both guests from her memory.
In his own Calendar tab, Cori fills in the event, adds the guests and saves it with the invitations.
It sits at 11 AM on her calendar, which is 2 PM in New York.
The chat says it was added, with Delete event if she changes her mind.
A date she never typed comes from her memory. With Autonomous on, Cori just does it.
Cori only invites the people you name.
